description: This source file contains a test case for integrating Metal compute kernels with PyTorch's MPS backend on Apple platforms. It defines a custom Metal kernel, wraps Metal API calls for setting up, dispatching, and synchronizing GPU tasks, and verifies the correctness of GPU computations against CPU results. The code also includes GoogleTest assertions for testing availability and result accuracy.

methods.name: getMTLBufferStorage
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch tensor's data to an MTLBuffer interface for Metal GPU operations.
